packageRules.description: Python 3.15 is not ready: this service shares the news-crawler runtime, where lxml 6.0.2 publishes no cp315 wheel and python:3.15-slim lacks the libxml2/libxslt development packages, so the Docker build fails (news-crawler PR #26). Disable major/minor python bumps so the runtime stays on the 3.12 line; patch-level 3.12.x updates still flow. Re-enable once the whole stack supports 3.15.
